claude_proposed_widenings.name: ContainerStorageProfile.retrievalAction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The storage profile captures capacity, weight override, air, and extradimensionality, but it cannot encode the action cost to retrieve stored contents.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.overloaded_or_damaged
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing destruction policy surface only covers last-charge rolls and deterministic exhaustion. Bag of Holding needs a non-charge destruction trigger tied to overload or physical damage, with a destination for contents.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extradimensional_space_collision
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive storage family has no way to express a passive item-item interaction that destroys both items, opens a transient gate, and exiles nearby creatures in an area. This is a triggered composition gap, not a missing top-level unit kind.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane.
